items.author: Lisa Hitch, MPH, Nov 26, 5h ago
items.summary: Gave Tableau Studio the same radar-chart prompt twice: the worksheet version came out as a line chart (the agent admitted "No true radar chart"), while the Data App produced a real interactive radar with toggles for age, gender, education and income. Takeaway: try hard-to-build charts as data apps. 8 reactions, 3 comments.
